name: com.mindattic.unity.multiplayer
description: Reusable multiplayer for Unity 6 games: attribute-decorated RPCs ([ToServer], [ToClients], [ToOwner], [ToClient], [Synced]), listen-server or dedicated-server topologies, and joining by IP:port or a join code. Built on Netcode for GameObjects and Unity Transport, hidden behind MindAttic's own API. Unity Relay join codes light up when com.unity.services.multiplayer is installed (MINDATTIC_UGS).

samples.description: The 10-minute start: host, join by IP or join by code from a small menu, and squares moved by the server through one [ToServer] call, one [ToClients] call and one [Synced] field. Open Minimal.unity and press Play; README.md walks through every line.
